Bill.BriefDescription: Providing legal services for persons under the supervision of the department of social and health services or corrections.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the provision of legal services for personsunder the supervision of the department of social and health servicesor corrections; adding a new section to chapter 72.01 RCW; andrepealing RCW 72.09.190.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is the intent of the legislature that reasonable legalservices be provided to persons committed to any institution under thesupervision of the department of social and health services orcorrections. The department shall contract with persons ororganizations to provide legal services. The secretary shall adoptprocedures designed to minimize any conflict of interest, or appearancethereof, in respect to the provision of legal services and thedepartment's administration of such contracts. (2) Persons who contract to provide legal services are expresslyforbidden to solicit plaintiffs or promote litigation that has not beenpursued initially by a person entitled to such services under thissection. p. 1 HB 2593 (3) Persons who contract to provide legal services shall exhaustall informal means of resolving a legal complaint or dispute prior tothe filing of any court proceeding. (4) Nothing in this section forbids the secretary to supplementcontracted legal services with any of the following: (a) Lawlibraries; (b) law student interns; and (c) volunteer attorneys. (5) The total due a contractor as compensation, fees, orreimbursement under the terms of the contract shall be reduced by thetotal of any other compensation, fees, or reimbursement received by ordue the contractor for the performance of any legal service to personscommitted to an institution under the supervision of the departmentduring the contract period. Any amount received by a contractor undercontract that is not due under this section shall be immediatelyreturned by the contractor.
RCW 72.09.190 (Legal services for inmates)and 1981 c 136 s 23 are each repealed.
